summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Steve Hoeft as Chief Operating Officer for its U.S. collision business and Zach Balthrop as Chief Commercial Officer, effective April 22, 2026. No financial terms, stake percentages, or premium were disclosed; it is a routine management restructuring to strengthen the executive team. The board did not provide a formal recommendation. The filing represents a standard leadership change, not a special situation event. Watch for any subsequent operational updates or strategic shifts tied to the new roles.
